description: Ministry of Justice and National Integration - Order under Section 02 of the Transfer of Offenders Act, No. of 1995
categorisation: The gazette content is a Government Notification under the "TRANSFER OF OFFENDERS ACT, No. 5 OF 1995." It is an Order made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to declare that the provisions of that Act apply to the Republic of Latvia. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action—specifically, the application of an existing law to a new jurisdiction. While a minister's name and title are present, the core purpose is not about the minister's appointment or portfolio responsibilities, nor is it about government structure. The primary subject is the extension of a legal act, fitting squarely within Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
